title: Dill Pickle Vegan Dumplings
description: A delicious vegan take on traditional dumplings. This recipe combines the flavors of dill, pickle, and umami to create a mouthwatering dish.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and salt. Gradually add water and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into small balls.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of dill pickle juice in the center of each circle.
Sprinkle chopped dill on top of the juice.
Fold the dough over to form a half-moon shape and press edges together to seal the dumpling.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add a tablespoon of oil to the skillet and swirl it around.
Add the dumplings to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
